# Nexow

> Nexow is an AI-native workspace for financial markets. You describe a widget in
> plain language — a chart, table, heatmap or signal — and Nexow generates its
> source code with Anthropic's Claude, runs it in a sandboxed iframe, and streams
> live market data onto a free-form canvas. Around the canvas it adds cloud bots,
> AI agents, a Copilot and a maker community. It is private by default: in local
> mode, codegen runs in your browser with your own Anthropic API key and your
> widgets persist locally in IndexedDB — no account required. A free account is
> optional and unlocks AI credits, cloud sync and the network.

## Key facts

- Category: AI-native workspace / dashboard & widget builder for trading and market data, with cloud automations and a community.
- How it works: prompt → AI-generated widget source → sandboxed iframe runtime → live data via connectors → refine in natural language.
- Structure: Workspaces contain Screens, which hold Widgets on a free-form canvas; Links pipe data between widgets.
- Privacy: private by default and no account required; bring-your-own-key codegen runs client-side; widgets, versions and logs stored in the browser (IndexedDB); many venues connect browser-direct.
- Automate: Bots are cloud automations (thresholds, % change, MA crossovers, digests) that fire signals and alerts to widgets even with the tab closed; Agents run a full harness (model, memory, skills, tools, knowledge, triggers) in the cloud (deploy coming soon); Copilot is a workspace AI assistant (coming soon).
- Network: a free account adds a community feed, a widget marketplace, audited strategy signals you can subscribe to and earn on, cross-device cloud sync, and XP & rewards.
- Connectors (28 live, 56 in catalog): OANDA, Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Deribit, BitMEX, Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, TradeStation, Polygon, Alpha Vantage, Intrinio, IQFeed, Rithmic, LMAX, FXCM, Kalshi, Polymarket, Trading Economics, Postgres, ClickHouse, Qdrant, plus socials (X, YouTube, Discord, Telegram, Spotify).
- Markets covered: FX, crypto, equities, futures, options and prediction markets.
- AI models: Anthropic Claude via the Anthropic SDK — Claude Opus 4.8 (default), Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5.
- Pricing: free forever to build (locally with your own key, or 10,000 AI credits on a free account). Paid plans — Supporter ($9.99/mo, 50K credits, 30 bots, 10 agents) and Sponsor ($69.99/mo, 800K credits, 300 bots, 100 agents) — plus Partner (custom, for teams). Yearly billing gives two months free. Paid checkout is coming soon.
- Status: public preview live (canvas, codegen, connectors, cloud bots, accounts & sync). Roadmap: agent deploy, Copilot, marketplace and strategy signals.
- App: https://app.nexow.ai
